review:
Book of Hidden Tombs is a 10-line Egyptian book slot with two free spins rounds and progressive multipliers. A golden book serves as both scatter and wild, in the familiar format.

You can trigger regular Free Spins or the stronger Super Free Spins, with multipliers that grow as the round continues, adding risk-reward moments to a classic structure. Chance x2 doubles the odds of reaching free spins at a slightly higher bet, and both bonus versions can be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins land about once every 197 spins.
